0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 3rd in the Southwest and 9th in the West), who have won their only road game and lost both at home. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met in 2026-27 yet, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost all three games to the Spurs, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
